description: Gated activation: out = act(x[..., :d]) * x[..., d:] with d = width // 2 (silu_and_mul, gelu_and_mul, gelu_tanh_and_mul). For a fused quantized output use rmsnorm_quant's output bounds as an override.
call: Return out; when the entry writes a preallocated out, allocate it inside call() so every call returns a fresh tensor.

timing.cache: x is the GEMM output just written; L2-warm in serving.

negative_controls: swap gate and up halves: act applied to the wrong half, error ~|out|
replace sigmoid with a first-order approximation: error grows with |x|, std 2 inputs reach it
pitfalls: std 2.0 inputs exercise the saturating tails of sigmoid/erf/tanh; N(0,1) barely leaves the linear region and hides a bad approximation.
One bf16 ulp of rtol plus a 1e-6 floor: the activation is computed in fp32 and rounded once; an fp16/bf16 intermediate costs an extra rounding the bound exposes.
